actor_protocol: local browser; temperature 0.6, top-p 0.95, top-k 20; 4096 new tokens; 30 turns; 32768-token SGLang context cap
limitations: The 32768-token serving cap is below the source model 262144-token context and training 36864-token cutoff. Context-limit HTTP 400 aborts were 77 NTP versus 140 Soft; this is an operational result under that cap, not an isolated estimate of action quality or Soft-MTP gradient routing.
Valid-only rates condition on arm-specific subsets (145 NTP versus 115 Soft); the 70 common-valid tasks offer a paired quality check but are selected by both actors reaching a valid outcome.
Judge model differs from historical o4-mini cohorts; do not compare rates across judge cohorts without a matched rejudge.
One evaluation draw per task; sampling variance and live-site drift remain.

paired.bootstrap: 20,000 paired task resamples with replacement; seed 42; percentile 95% interval; fixed checkpoints and one evaluation draw per task

serving_comparison: Actor-only generation for both; Soft-MTP draft heads discarded. No speculative decoding or MTP serving-speed claim.
title: Matched NTP-only versus Soft-MTP SFT actor-only Online-Mind2Web evaluation
training_comparison: Fresh matched base Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking SFT, 3085 examples, 579 steps/3 epochs each; Soft-MTP adds three K=3 draft heads and the auxiliary Soft-MTP gradient route.
